name: single-mode laser

slots.Xi: field amplitude amp and population inversion inv: R^2
slots.C: one cavity mode; the inversion is pumped at rate P and relaxes at gamma; spontaneous emission enters as additive noise on amp
slots.R: sign of the field amplitude (optical phase 0 or pi)
slots.P: bounded write toward a target, release, measurement; sweep of P
slots.A: P=1.5, g=1, kappa=1, gamma=1; control P in (0.3, 2.0); noise D=0.005

provenance: Haken, Rev. Mod. Phys. 47, 67 (1975); semiclassical single-mode laser with a real field amplitude

events.kind: supercritical pitchfork: symmetric write; a small bias chooses the state

required: No obstruction: along the critical direction the target realizes the pitchfork generator eps s - |a3| s^3 + h, with eps proportional to the distance of the control from its critical value.

threshold_source: largest restoring force on the straight path

verdict.lock: field 0.4 x threshold, fixed control: accuracy 0.03, not rewritten; field 1.5 x threshold, fixed control: accuracy 0.05, not rewritten; field 0.4 x threshold, control swept through the write point: accuracy 0.40, not rewritten
